text.en:
Period of registration. The registration of qualified voters provided under Presidential Decree
No. 1187 shall be undertaken on October twenty-nine; thirty, November four and five, nineteen
seventy-seven, from seven o'clock in the morning to seven o'clock in the evening.

Appropriations. To carry out the objectives of Presidential Decree No. 1187, the amount of Eight
million eight hundred fifty thousand (P8,850,000.00) pesos only is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the
National Treasury not otherwise appropriated to be spent under the exclusive authority of the Commission on

Effectivity. This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 19th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
